title: The Achilus Assault
author: steve-parker
description: The Jericho Reach is a vast warzone on the edge of Imperial space where Tyranids, Orks and Chaos press in from every side. Deathwatch kill-teams are deployed across the Reach's myriad warzones, each mission a surgical strike against xenos threats no ordinary Astartes can handle.

title: Deathwatch
author: steve-parker
description: Talon Squad — a Deathwatch kill-team assembled from warriors of different Chapters — is dispatched to an isolated world where Tyranid genestealers have infiltrated the population. Their mission demands not just combat skill but the hardest of all Astartes virtues: the ability to work as brothers across Chapter lines.

title: Warzone Damocles
author: various
description: An anthology of Deathwatch stories set during the Damocles Gulf Crusade and its aftermath. Multiple kill-teams, multiple worlds — each tale a surgical strike by the Imperium's specialist xenos hunters against Tau, Tyranids and stranger foes on the Eastern Fringe.
